description: Decision sequence for /mockups --consolidate (#2589). Externalized per the AC48 line-count guardrail: the ordered prompt procedure is spec-specific reference content, which is exactly what that budget exists to force out of CommandsSrc/mockups.md. The command spec keeps the contract statements and directs the reader here for the sequence. Re-read from disk at use time; never paraphrase from memory.

rules: Reuse Step 1b discovery to scan Mockups/ for {Name}/ sets, inventorying Specs/, Screens/, AsciiScreens/ and AC/ per set.
Mockups/Deprecated/ is never a candidate.
Fewer than two sets found - report and STOP; there is nothing to consolidate.

decisions.summary: For each discovered set, one question listing that set's mockup files.
rules: One listing per source set (Mockups/{Name}/) - never a single flattened list across sets, so the origin of every pick stays visible.
Skipping an entire set is a valid answer.
Pre-fill a suggested directory name; the user may override it.
A name colliding with an existing set is re-prompted, never overwritten.

decisions.summary: Resolve competing renditions of the same screen.
rules: Fires when two or more selections resolve to the same screen name.
List options as {set}/{file} with dates.
Losers are recorded as superseded, not copied.

decisions.summary: Write Mockups/{Target}/ as a normal mockup set.
rules: Standard subdirectories: Specs/, Screens/, AsciiScreens/, AC/.
Each carried-forward mockup gains a `**Supersedes:**` header line beside `**Screen Spec:**`, naming source set and source file.
The set's README.md (Step 5) gains a `## Consolidation` section recording source set, source file, superseded renditions, and date.
Screen specs travel with their mockups: Specs/ moves too and each entry's canonicalSpec is repointed at the new path.
Rewrite stale `## Related Artifacts` cross-references to the consolidated paths, reusing Step 4's rewrite. Specs move, so not rewriting guarantees stale links.

decisions.summary: Explicit question: is the consolidation complete?
rules: No pre-existing file is moved before this answer.
Everything before this point writes only into the new target set.
Suggest Mockups/Deprecated/{suggested}; the user may override it.
Affected means carried forward or superseded.
Deprecation is a move, never a delete.
Prefer `git mv` so file history follows the file.
Fall back to a plain move only when git mv is unavailable or fails, and report which was used.

decisions.summary: Bring screen-catalog.json and NAVIGATION.md back in line with the new paths.
rules: Update Mockups/screen-catalog.json via loadCatalog / upsertScreen / saveCatalog (.claude/scripts/shared/lib/screen-catalog.js).
Set moved entries to status: "deprecated" - a value screen-catalog-schema.json's enum already permits.
Point consolidated entries at their new paths.
upsertScreen is pure: thread its return value into saveCatalog or the upsert is silently discarded (#2380).
Regenerate Mockups/NAVIGATION.md via renderNavigationMarkdown (.claude/scripts/shared/lib/navigation-graph.js) after paths change.

decisions.summary: Report the result and offer a commit.
rules: Reuse Step 8b's commit offer.
Refs #NN only when issue context happens to exist; a plain descriptive message otherwise.
Mockups/Deprecated/ is excluded from the --serve tree.
status: deprecated entries are filtered out of the showcase bundle.
Absent status is not deprecation - entries predating this feature carry no status field and must keep rendering.
